name: POST /api/auth/sso/signup - create a workspace after Google/Microsoft sign-in
description: Public: consumes the one-time sign-up code and, in one transaction, creates the account (no password: it signs in through the provider), links the provider identity, creates the firm with this person as owner and returns a session (201). The email comes only from the verified ID token. Covers: a consultant can sign up and create a firm workspace; a user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO.

errorCases.when: fullName or firmName missing, or code malformed

errorCases.message: An account with this email already exists
errorCases.when: an account with the email was created after the code was issued
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Race between two sign-ups for one email; needs a provider round trip.

happyPathNote: Success needs a code minted by a real provider round trip; verified with a local OIDC mock.
